NUMBER:
8452
 
AUTHOR:
Aeschylus
 (525–456 B.C.)
 
QUOTATION:
Words are the physicians of a mind diseased.
 
1
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Prometheus, 378.
 
 
 
Note 1.
Apt words have power to suage
The tumours of a troubl’d mind.
John Milton
: 
Samson Agonistes.
